# Com Pors | Leading Tech Intelligence, AI & Systems Architecture

> Com Pors is an independent technology journal delivering daily investigative journalism, software architecture blueprints, semiconductor analysis, and enterprise IT evaluations.

## Editorial Newsroom & Organization
- Website: https://www.compors.com
- RSS / Sitemap: https://www.compors.com/sitemap.xml
- Authors & Masthead: https://www.compors.com/authors/
- Editorial Standards: https://www.compors.com/about/
- Newsroom Inquiries: https://www.compors.com/contact/

## Core Coverage Categories
- Artificial Intelligence: https://www.compors.com/category/artificial-intelligence/
  - Neural networks, frontier LLMs, autonomous agents, and generative machine learning.
- Software Engineering & Architecture: https://www.compors.com/category/software-engineering/
  - High-throughput distributed systems, API architecture, and software design patterns.
- Cloud Computing: https://www.compors.com/category/cloud-computing/
  - Kubernetes orchestration, serverless microservices, and enterprise cloud infrastructure.
- Cybersecurity: https://www.compors.com/category/cybersecurity/
  - Zero trust network architecture, threat intelligence, and defensive tooling.
- Hardware & Semiconductors: https://www.compors.com/category/hardware-semiconductors/
  - Microprocessor architectures, AI accelerators, and silicon fabrication nodes.
